mapper.select:
select B.MENU_ID from SYS_MENU B left join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID where SRM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND B.TYPE = 'ADMIN' AND B.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND B.APP_ID = #{currAppId}
and B.MENU_ID not in (select B.PARENT_ID from SYS_MENU B inner join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID and SRM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId})
order by B.PARENT_ID, B.PRIORITY

select distinct B.PERMS from SYS_MENU B left join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID left join ADMIN_USER_ROLE AUR on SRM.ROLE_ID = AUR.ROLE_ID where 1 = 1 AND B.TYPE = 'ADMIN' AND B.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND B.APP_ID = #{currAppId}

select distinct B.PERMS from SYS_MENU B left join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID left join ADMIN_USER_ROLE AUR on SRM.ROLE_ID = AUR.ROLE_ID left join SYS_ROLE RO on RO.ROLE_ID = AUR.ROLE_ID where B.IS_DISABLED = 0 and RO.STATUS = 0 AND B.TYPE = 'ADMIN' AND B.DEL_FLAG = 0 and AUR.ADMIN_ID = #{userId}
AND B.APP_ID = #{currAppId}
select count(1) from SYS_MENU where PARENT_ID = #{parentId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0
mapper.delete: delete from SYS_MENU where PARENT_ID=#{parentId} AND URL_TYPE = 'BUTTON'
mapper.select: SELECT M.MENU_ID, M.PARENT_ID, M.NAME, M.ENAME FROM SYS_MENU M WHERE 1 = 1 AND M.PARENT_ID = #{menuId} AND M.URL_TYPE = 'BUTTON'
